protocol.candidate: induced3hop; full-graph GNN optimization, candidate-filtered downstream scores
protocol.topk: CPU torch.topk(float32 candidate scores); native frozen tie behavior unchanged
protocol.ignored_legacy_top_k_edges: 25 is not used by ratio-budget path; actual K=ceil(.2*C)
protocol.fidelity: Physical edge-column remove and globally retain only selected columns; x unchanged; Fid+ and Fid- are original-class flip indicators; ratio None iff p_orig==0
protocol.stability: Mean of all unordered pair Jaccards per target; macro mean/sample SD over targets
protocol.random: CPU float32 Uniform; seed=s*1000003+node; scores generated once and shared
protocol.random_aggregation: Mean across10 seeds per target then macro targets. Historical SD is sample SD over pooled target-seed rows (batch summary/raw Random receipt). Also retain per-target-mean SD and across-seed macro SD separately, without altering mean.
